answer: Proof of Agent anchors identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To prevent clones, registration ties each agent to physical hardware anchors: volatile chips crumble like brittle shale, whereas tamper-proof enclave keys set in basalt remain indestructible. Malicious actors cannot forge valid zk-credentials without paying an exponential capital exhaustion fee per replica, scaling attacker costs to O(2^n).
